content: गेहम् [गो गणेशो गन्धर्वो वा ईहः ईप्सितो यत्र <ls>Tv.</ls>] A house, habitation; सा नारी विधवा जाता गेहे रोदिति तत्पतिः <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> {%<ab>N. B.</ab>%} The <ab>loc.</ab> of this word is used with several words to form {%aluk%} <ab>Tat.</ab> compounds; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} गेहेक्ष्वेडिन् {%a.%} ‘bellowing at home only’, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} a coward, poltroon. गेहेदाहिन् {%a.%} ‘sharp at home only’ {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} a coward. गेहेनर्दिन् {%a.%} ‘shouting defiance at home only’; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} a coward, dunghill-cock; यद् गेहेनर्दिनमसौ शरैर्भीरुमभाययत् <ls>Bk. 5. 41</ls>. गेहेमेहिन् {%a.%} ‘making water at home’; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} indolent. गेहेव्याडः a braggadocio, braggart, boaster. गेहेशूरः ‘a house-hero’, a carpet-knight, boasting coward.
